mechanics.honeyRule: Honey replaces the normal pool with the two rarest distinct species in that habitat.

honeyPoolShares.note: Unboosted shares from the server honey weights. Active world boosts may alter unlikely encounter odds.

mechanics.shinyRule: Shiny odds and active server boosts are intentionally displayed live in game rather than frozen into this guide.
mechanics.celebrationRule: Staff-scheduled Alpha Celebration swarms are dynamic and appear in game while active; they are not fixed route spawns.
